title: Rabbi Chizkiyah of Akko
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Hyman mentions him in Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat, chapter 14, halakhah 4, speaking in the name of the Rabbis of Caesarea, and notes that in Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah, chapter 2, halakhah 2, the word עכייה (“of Akko”) is absent.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The Guggenheimer digital text of Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 14:4 includes the Akko epithet; its Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 2:2 parallel names Chizkiyah without that epithet. These two named passages support the stated textual comparison.

The whole Guggenheimer Shabbat 14:4 paragraph fully names Rabbi Chizkiyah with the Akko epithet in the name of the Rabbis of Caesarea. The whole selected Avodah Zarah 2:2 paragraph fully names Rabbi Chizkiyah without that epithet. These support the local title and bounded comparison already stated in the retained note, without claiming absence throughout either tractate.
